description.text:
The seventh set of the EX series, released on 8 November 2004 with 111 cards, 109 numbered and two secret rares, and two theme decks named for Jessie and James. Four years after the original Team Rocket set, it brought the villains of FireRed and LeafGreen back, and with them Dark Pokémon: now mostly dual-type, and many with as much HP as their ordinary versions. Rocket's Pokémon join them, among them Rocket's Pokémon-ex such as Rocket's Mewtwo ex and the three legendary birds, mostly pure Darkness type.

It also introduced Pokémon Star, holo rares of the games' alternate-color Pokémon, marked with a star beside the name; a deck may hold only one. They work much like the Shining Pokémon of Neo Revelation, and they were the first cards whose artwork breaks out of its frame. The first three were Treecko, Torchic and Mudkip.
